faqs.question: What are your delivery charges and shipping times?
faqs.answer:
🚚 **Nationwide Shipping & COD:**

• **Major Cities (Lahore, Karachi, Islamabad/Rawalpindi):** 2–4 working days
• **Nationwide Pakistan:** 4–6 working days
• **Complimentary Insured Delivery:** Free on orders above **PKR 15,000** (PKR 500 standard courier below PKR 15,000).

What is your return and warranty policy?

faqs.question: What is your return, exchange, and warranty policy?
faqs.answer:
🛡️ **7-Day Easy Return & Exchange:**

• Unused watches in original packaging can be returned or exchanged within **7 days** if damaged in transit or if an incorrect model is received.
• Every timepiece undergoes a pre-dispatch movement & quality inspection.
• Contact WhatsApp **+92 328 4037431** with your order details or unboxing video for quick support.
suggestedFollowUps: How can I contact Mix Inventories?

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer:
💳 **Payment Methods:**

• **Cash on Delivery (COD)** nationwide across Pakistan
• **Bank Transfer** & direct coordination via WhatsApp Concierge (**+92 328 4037431**).

faqs.question: How do I place an order?
faqs.answer:
🛍️ **How to Order:**

1. Tap **Add to Bag** on any timepiece and proceed to Checkout, OR
2. Click **Order on WhatsApp** inside any watch detail view to confirm directly with our concierge (**+92 328 4037431**).

faqs.question: What brands and movements do you offer?
faqs.answer:
⌚ **Curated Brands & Movements:**

We curate **Omega, Tissot, Patek Philippe, Richard Mille, Cartier, TAG Heuer, Tubular, and Martyn Line** across **Automatic, Semi-Automatic, and Quartz** movements.
